Rivon — Free Website Template for Framer

name: Rivon
summary: Free minimal portfolio template for Framer with CMS-powered project pages and case studies.
description: A free Framer website template for product designers, UI/UX designers, freelancers and design studios: strong typography, structured case studies, responsive layouts and reusable components. Projects are connected to the Framer CMS, so updating a project once refreshes its cards, sections and detail pages. Includes setup documentation. By Mahmoud Anbousi.
contains: case studies, responsive layouts, reusable components
